capabilities: Transcribe photos of handwritten pages into Markdown notes
Transcribe voice memos and uploaded audio or PDFs
File notes into folders with automatic dates, titles, and frontmatter via user-defined flows
Summarize, translate, extract action items, or reformat notes with custom instructions
Email notes from e-ink tablets or share from phone apps into the vault
disambiguation: Not a writing-focus or typing-flow tool; despite the name it captures handwriting and voice from outside the vault and transcribes them into notes.
extras: Freemium credit model: 25 free credits, one page of handwriting or one minute of audio per credit, top-up packs instead of subscriptions; installation, usage, privacy, and troubleshooting details live on a separate documentation site.
motivation: The authors still write by hand and wanted their handwritten pages to live in their favorite app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn handwritten pages, whiteboard photos, or voice memos into searchable, automatically filed text notes.

relations.evidence: it also integrates with Notion, Google Docs, and OneNote
Email notes from your reMarkable, Boox, Supernote, or Daylight to your unique Flowstate address

requires.name: Flowstate credits beyond the free tier

summary: Service-backed capture pipeline that transcribes handwritten page photos and voice memos into formatted Markdown notes filed in the vault.
